readerCopy.body: Another person's sudden change can expose how much an old protection strategy depended on the surrounding world staying predictable. When Uranus opposes Chiron, disruption and sensitivity face each other directly, making a cancellation, departure, changed system, or unexpected demand activate fears that were easier to manage under familiar conditions. If a sudden change is stirring up an older fear, you may notice that the support actually lost is smaller and more specific than every defense the surprise makes tempting to rebuild. The disruption can be inconvenient without recreating the original danger.
